title: Return of the Snow Monster
description: Return of the Snow Monster — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Shivery the Incorrigible Snowman

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Speak with Shivery the Incorrigible Snowman to travel to the Sanctuary of the Snowmen and kill The Abominable Snow Dog.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Shivery the Incorrigible Snowman

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Speak with Shivery the Incorrigible Snowman to travel to the Sanctuary of the Snowmen and kill The Abominable Snow Dog.

Offer:

It's that time of year again kids. The snow is falling, snow monsters are invading and your old pal Shivery needs another favor.

A new snow monster with a taste for snowman snow has invaded the Sanctuary of the Snowmen. I barely escaped with my carrot intact! It was horrible. Coal, twigs and pounds of snow everywhere!

Bring some holiday cheer to my ice cold heart and defeat The Abominable Snow Dog.

Turn-in:

You succeeded again? You're a regular overachiever now arent you. Sort of makes me sick but th..than...thannnk... thank you!

Objectives:

  • Kill The Abominable Snow Dog

Client level range: 5–?
